4.3.1.10 Buffering
[SWS_Rte_02515]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00110
⌈The buffering of sender-receiver communication shall be done on the receiver side.
This does not imply that COM does no buffering on the sender side. On the receiver
side, two different approaches are taken for the buffering of ‘data’ and of ‘events’,
depending on the value of the software implementation policy.⌋
caption: 4.3.1.10 Buffering

targets.why: buffering of data on receiver side
